title: The reduced crystallographic pairing of a splitting Cartan subalgebra
statement:
Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero and $L$ a finite-dimensional $K$-Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra]. Assume that its Killing form $B(x,y)=\operatorname{Tr}_L(\operatorname{ad}(x)\operatorname{ad}(y))$ is nondegenerate, meaning $B(x,-)=0$ implies $x=0$. Let $H\subseteq L$ be a Cartan subalgebra: its lower central series eventually vanishes and its normalizer $\{x\in L:[x,H]\subseteq H\}$ equals $H$. Assume each $\operatorname{ad}(h)$ for $h\in H$ is triangularizable over $K$ (its generalized eigenspaces with eigenvalues in $K$ span $L$). For a linear functional $\alpha:H\to K$ put
$$E_\alpha=\{x\in L:\ \forall h\in H\ \exists n\geq0,\ (\operatorname{ad}(h)-\alpha(h)\mathrm{id})^n x=0\}.$$
Assume also that $B|_{H\times H}$ is nondegenerate. Put $R=\{\alpha\in H^\vee:\alpha\ne0,\ E_\alpha\ne0\}$. For $\alpha\in R$ let $t_\alpha\in H$ be defined by $B(t_\alpha,h)=\alpha(h)$ and assume $\alpha(t_\alpha)\ne0$; put $c_\alpha=2t_\alpha/\alpha(t_\alpha)$. Then the root family $\alpha\mapsto\alpha$ and coroot family $\alpha\mapsto c_\alpha$ form a reduced crystallographic root system for the evaluation pairing $H^\vee\times H\to K$. Explicitly both families are injective and span their respective spaces, $\alpha(c_\alpha)=2$, and $\beta(c_\alpha)$ lies in the image of $\mathbf Z\to K$ for every $\alpha,\beta\in R$. Proportional roots are equal or negatives. For each $\alpha\in R$, the transformations
$$s_\alpha(\xi)=\xi-\xi(c_\alpha)\alpha,\qquad s_\alpha^\vee(h)=h-\alpha(h)c_\alpha$$
permute the root and coroot families with the same permutation of $R$.
